blocks.text: Possible origin. A Restoration faction combines archives, models, witness records, and continuity material into a being resembling an ancient DBA but lacking proven uninterrupted identity.
Function. The Claimant can demand rights without claiming a cyber-pet’s body, or inherit ancient claims that threaten new persons.
Risk. Deletion repeats old violence; automatic deference revives Correction Culture. Recognition must not surrender the future to the past.
